name: TC-SR-003 — 买手审核视图交互 [P0]
description: 验证审核视图：左侧图组导航、参考图、试拍图横向大图、弃用单图/整组、撤销弃用
page: 迭代详情-试拍与评审 tab

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const viewSwitch = document.querySelector('[class*=view-switch]'); const leftNav = document.querySelector('[class*=group-nav], [class*=sidebar]'); const reviewRecord = document.querySelector('[class*=review-record], [class*=phase-status]'); const submitBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('提交审核')); return { viewSwitch: !!viewSwitch, leftNav: !!leftNav, reviewRecord: !!reviewRecord, submitBtn: !!submitBtn }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const hasReview = text.includes('审核视图') || text.includes('结果视图'); const hasRecord = text.includes('判定标准') || text.includes('通过组数') || text.includes('评审记录'); return { hasViewSwitch: hasReview, hasReviewRecord: hasRecord }; })()
steps.description: 验证视图切换和评审记录组件

_testDesign.preconditions: 迭代状态为IN_REVIEW，当前用户是店铺买手
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 进入试拍与评审tab
2. 验证默认进入审核视图
3. 检查左侧图组导航
4. 检查评审记录组件
5. 检查弃用操作入口
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 默认进入审核视图
2. 左侧展示图组缩略图导航
3. 右侧展示参考图和试拍图横向大图
4. 图片上展示弃用入口
5. 试拍评审记录组件展示判定标准和当前结论
6. 底部展示提交审核按钮
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/试拍与评审
